//: Local development only. The connection strings below point at the dedicated containers defined in the repo-root docker-compose.yml — bring them up with `docker compose up -d` before running the API. The ports are deliberately not 5432/6379: 5432 belongs to the machine's native PostgreSQL service, and the defaults are what neighbouring projects' compose files also claim. These credentials are a local container's, not secrets — real secrets (Jwt:Key, the Hangfire dashboard login, SMTP) stay in User Secrets. If you set ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection in User Secrets, it OVERRIDES this file and the app will talk to whatever that points at instead.
